description: This file defines the 'License' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the context of report display fields related to employee licenses. It provides methods for normalizing license data for reporting purposes and references Employee entity data.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) representing a license associated with an employee, capable of normalizing license information for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the License DTO with an employee number, used to retrieve the employee's license data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the license data into an array based on specified fields, utilizing employee license information.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of report field names to corresponding getter methods in the Employee or License entities for data extraction.
